findings.title: Source-aware calculation explanations
findings.next_action: Emit selected-metric provenance and omitted-effect reasons.
findings.limitation: No copied game formulas; do not replace existing verified stat assembly.

findings.title: Persist explicit scenario assumptions
findings.next_action: Start with one supported scenario and context identity.
findings.limitation: Configured state is not evidence of actual uptime.

findings.title: Keep full build state separate from passive code
findings.next_action: Preserve native POV1 plus versioned supported gear/skill/scenario state.
findings.limitation: PoB XML is not compatible with POV1 or a proposed Valheiman manifest.

findings.title: Evaluate complete path packages and choices
findings.next_action: Show total delta, incremental cost and per-point change after legality checks.
findings.limitation: Local path impact is not a global optimum; overlapping paths require union accounting.

findings.title: Use local weights only for screening
findings.next_action: Shortlist item/affix candidates, then fully recalculate finalists.
findings.limitation: Synergies, caps and trade-offs make marginal weights context-dependent.

findings.title: Build and interaction regression fixtures
findings.next_action: Add explicit complete-input fixtures and generated-report/data checks.
findings.limitation: Saved expected outputs are regression evidence, not an independent game oracle.

findings.title: Access-changing jewel dependencies
findings.next_action: Trace native access grants and add removal/replacement tests.
findings.limitation: PoE jewel mechanics cannot establish Dunin legality.

findings.title: Memoization and bounded background work
findings.next_action: Test cold/warm equivalence and context invalidation before caching.
findings.limitation: Never reuse by mod identity alone across different contexts.

findings.title: Reference architecture is preferable to a runtime bridge
findings.next_action: Adapt focused ideas; retain Valheiman formulas and units.
findings.limitation: The headless wrapper still loads the PoB application and PoE data model.

findings.title: Preserve source notices when actually reusing implementation
findings.next_action: Record upstream revision and retain applicable notices.
findings.limitation: Top-level source notice does not establish rights to every game asset.
